highrisk.title: Notice for privileged users
highrisk.p1: You are signed in with extended access rights (BGT – professional confidentiality obligation).
highrisk.p2: Some of your chat requests are checked for certain keywords (e.g. diagnoses, medications, mental illnesses). If a match is found, the following is logged: time, your username, the tool used, and the detected category – never the content of your request itself.
highrisk.p3: This logging serves to ensure traceability when handling particularly sensitive data, not to monitor your work.
demo.title: This is a demo system
demo.p1: For demonstration purposes, {{APP_NAME}} is running here on an external server not operated locally and uses an online language model from a third-party provider – unlike a production installation that is fully self-hosted.
demo.p2: Your input is sent to this external AI service to generate a response. Please do not enter any real, confidential, or personal data here.
demo.p3: By continuing, you acknowledge these notices.
demo.continue: Got it, continue to sign in
